recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: How does your partner take their coffee or tea?
What photo is on their phone's lock screen?
Which side of the bed do they sleep on?
What do they always order at a restaurant?
What color do they wear the most?
Which song is on repeat for them?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Little things edition: 8 small questions about your partner. The tiny details count!

Comment your score!
